title: 第21章 蛛王的信使第22章 母蛛王会见
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
白荣接过名单，随意地翻阅着。
法诺则在一旁站着，双手不自觉地搓动着。
白荣察觉到了他的异样。
抬起头，有些好笑地看着他：“法诺城主，从我进来之后，你就一直不太自然，是不是有什么事？”
法诺被点破，脸上闪过一丝尴尬。
随即嘿嘿一笑：“还是被您看出来了，其实……也不是什么大事。就是……就是原本预定作为此次矿洞试炼头名奖励的那个10级兽王技能精髓……出了点意外。”
“哦？”
白荣挑眉。
法诺连忙解释：“城外的风狼王，昨天晚上不知道被谁给杀了，技能精髓也被人拿走了，所以……所以我们现在拿不出原本承诺的奖励，您看……”
白荣闻言，了然地点了点头。
脸上并无太多意外之色，他摆了摆手。
语气轻松地说道：“我当是什么事。原来是这样。无妨，如果此次试炼的第一名确实足够出色，我可以投入一个10级技能精髓，就当是提前投资了。”
法诺听到这话，一直悬着的心才终于放回了肚子里。
长长地舒了口气，脸上堆满了笑容：“有队长您这句话，我就放心了！真是太感谢您了！”
白荣笑了笑，目光重新落回名单上。
但似乎想起了什么，随口问道：“不过，能在古木城周边单独击杀风狼王……看来你们这里，还藏着一位实力不错的冒险者？知道是谁吗？”
法诺脸上刚刚放松的表情又变得有些难堪。
他摇了摇头：“我们查过了，记录在册的冒险者昨天都有记录，基本都可以排除。就怕……是其他城市路过的。”
“嗯。”
白荣点了点头，露出一副若有所思的表情，但没有再深究下去。

他的注意力被名单上的一个名字吸引。
手指点了点，“这个叫王同的，你做了特别标注？”
法诺立刻凑近些，压低声音。
“这个王同，是这批勇者里天赋最好的一个，升级速度很快。而且，此子心性……颇为成熟。他明明已经达到了10级，却声称只有9级，懂得隐藏实力。”
“哦？已经10级了？还懂得藏拙？”
白荣来了一丝兴趣，拿起王同的详细资料，仔细地查看起来。
对王同这个名字加深了几分印象。
然后又随意地翻看了一下名单。
对其中几个勇者简单点评了几句，便将其放下，与法诺聊起了其他事务。
帐篷内的谈话声渐渐低沉下去。
……
画面跳转回幽暗深邃的矿洞中层。
通道被银白色的光芒照亮。
“应该快到了。”
殷血翘着二郎腿坐在林默的肩膀上。
content_en:
Bai Rong took the list and flipped through it casually.
Fano stood aside, rubbing his hands unconsciously.
Bai Rong noticed something strange about him.
He raised his head and looked at him amusedly: "Lord Fano, you have been acting unnatural since I came in. Is there something wrong?"
Fano was exposed, and a trace of embarrassment flashed across his face.
Then he chuckled: "You still noticed it. Actually... it's not a big deal. It's just... that the essence of the level 10 Beastmaster skill that was originally scheduled to be the reward for the first place in this mine trial... had an accident."
"Oh?"
Bai Rong raised his eyebrows.
Fano quickly explained: "The Wind Wolf King outside the city was killed by someone last night, and the essence of his skills was also taken away, so... So now we can't get the rewards we originally promised, you see..."
When Bai Rong heard this, he nodded clearly.
There was not much surprise on his face, and he waved his hand.
He said in a relaxed tone: "What do I think it is? It turns out that it is like this. It doesn't matter, if the first place in this trial is really good enough, I can invest a level 10 skill essence, and it will be regarded as an early investment."
When Fano heard this, his heart that had been hanging finally returned to his stomach.
He breathed a long sigh of relief, with a smile on his face: "With your words, captain, I feel relieved! Thank you so much!"
Bai Rong smiled and looked back at the list.
But he seemed to remember something, and asked casually: "However, being able to kill the Wind Wolf King alone around Gumu City... It seems that you have a good adventurer hiding here? Do you know who it is?"
The relaxed expression on Fano's face turned a little embarrassed again.
He shook his head: "We have checked, and all the adventurers on the record were recorded yesterday. Basically, they can be ruled out. I'm afraid... they were passing by from other cities."
"Yeah."
Bai Rong nodded, showing a thoughtful expression, but did not delve deeper.
His attention was caught by a name on the list.
Pointing his finger, "This guy named Wang Tong, did you make a special mark?"
Fano immediately moved closer and lowered his voice.
"This Wang Tong is the most talented among these brave men. He upgrades very quickly. Moreover, his character... is quite mature. He has obviously reached level 10, but he claims to be only level 9. He knows how to hide his strength."
"Oh? Already level 10? Do you still know how to hide your clumsiness?"
Bai Rong became interested, picked up Wang Tong's detailed information, and looked at it carefully.
The name Wang Tong deepened my impression.
Then he flipped through the list casually.
After briefly commenting on a few of the heroes, he put them down and chatted with Fano about other matters.
The conversation in the tent gradually became muffled.
…
The screen jumps back to the dark and deep middle level of the mine.
The passage was illuminated by silvery white light.
"Should be arriving soon."
Yin Xue sat on Lin Mo's shoulders with his legs crossed.
